report: The Fate of Online Trust in the Next Decade
publisher: Pew Research Center and Elon University's Imagining the Internet Center

entries.label: Trust in online interactions
entries.quote: As more people move online globally, both opportunities and threats grow. Will people's trust in their online interactions, their work, shopping, social connections, pursuit of knowledge and other activities be strengthened or diminished over the next 10 years?
entries.subject: online trust
entries.note: Quote is the end of a longer prompt.
entries.answer_mapping: agree = trust strengthened; disagree = trust diminished

notes: One question from a canvassing of eight questions fielded 2016-07-01 to 2016-08-12. The question asks about 'the next decade' / 'the next 10 years' and names no year; target_year 2026 is read from that horizon (the jobs report itself says 'by 2026'). Non-random opt-in canvassing.
